subject: maths
question_en:
The stem-and-leaf diagram below shows the scores of 15 students in a test. Find the median of the scores.

$$
\begin{array}{r|l} \text{Stem (10)} & \text{Leaf (1)} \\\hline 4 & 2, 5, 8 \\\ 5 & 0, 3, 3, 6, 9 \\\ 6 & 1, 4, 4, 7, 8 \\\ 7 & 2, 5 \end{array}
$$
question_zh:
下表顯示 15 名學生在測驗中的得分。求得分的中位數。

$$
\begin{array}{r|l} \text{莖 (10)} & \text{葉 (1)} \\\hline 4 & 2, 5, 8 \\\ 5 & 0, 3, 3, 6, 9 \\\ 6 & 1, 4, 4, 7, 8 \\\ 7 & 2, 5 \end{array}
$$

subject: maths
question_en:
The stem-and-leaf diagram below shows the heights (cm) of 12 plants. Find the range of the heights.

$$
\begin{array}{r|l} \text{Stem (10)} & \text{Leaf (1)} \\\hline 10 & 2, 5, 5 \\\ 11 & 0, 3, 7, 8 \\\ 12 & 1, 4, 6, 9 \\\ 13 & 2 \end{array}
$$
question_zh:
下表顯示 12 株植物的高度 (cm)。求高度的全距。

$$
\begin{array}{r|l} \text{莖 (10)} & \text{葉 (1)} \\\hline 10 & 2, 5, 5 \\\ 11 & 0, 3, 7, 8 \\\ 12 & 1, 4, 6, 9 \\\ 13 & 2 \end{array}
$$

subject: maths
question_en: Find the mode of the following set of data: 12, 15, 12, 18, 20, 15, 12, 22, 18.
solution_steps_en: 1. Count frequencies: 12 appears 3 times, 15 and 18 appear twice.
2. The value with the highest frequency is 12.
solution_steps_zh: 1. 點算頻數：12 出現 3 次，15 和 18 各出現 2 次。

subject: maths
question_en: In a box-and-whisker diagram, the lower quartile, the median, and the upper quartile of a data set are 45, 62, and 78 respectively. Find the interquartile range (IQR).
question_zh: 在一盒形圖中，某數據集的下四分位數、中位數及上四分位數分別為 45、62 及 78。求四分位位距 (IQR)。

subject: maths
question_en: Find the interquartile range (IQR) of a data set if its 5-number summary is (10, 25, 40, 60, 95).
question_zh: 若某數據集的五數概括為 (10, 25, 40, 60, 95)，求其四分位位距 (IQR)。

subject: maths
question_en:
The frequency table below shows the number of pets owned by 20 families. Find the mean number of pets.

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|} \hline \text{No. of Pets } (x) & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \\\hline \text{Frequency } (f) & 4 & 7 & 5 & 3 & 1 \\\hline \end{array}
$$
question_zh:
下表顯示 20 個家庭擁有的寵物數量。求寵物數量的平均值。

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|} \hline \text{寵物數量 } (x) & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \\\hline \text{頻數 } (f) & 4 & 7 & 5 & 3 & 1 \\\hline \end{array}
$$

subject: maths
question_en:
The frequency table below shows the marks of a quiz. Find the interquartile range (IQR).

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|} \hline \text{Score } (x) & 2 & 3 & 4 & 5 & 6 \\\hline \text{Frequency } (f) & 3 & 5 & 8 & 6 & 2 \\\hline \end{array}
$$
question_zh: 下表顯示得分的分佈。求得分的四分位位距 (IQR)。

subject: maths
question_en: Compare the dispersion of heights between Class A and Class B. IQR of Class A is 30 cm and Class B is 22 cm. Which class has more varied heights?
question_zh: 比較 A 班與 B 班的高度離散程度。A 班的 IQR 為 30 cm，B 班為 22 cm。哪一班的高度較為離散？
solution_steps_en: 1. Dispersion can be measured by IQR.
2. 30 cm > 22 cm, so Class A has more varied heights.
solution_steps_zh: 1. 離散程度可用 IQR 衡量。
2. 30 cm > 22 cm，故 A 班的高度較為離散。

subject: maths
question_en: From an Ogive, the cumulative frequency of 40 kg is 35 and 60 kg is 80. If the total is 100, how many items are between 40 and 60 kg?
question_zh: 在一累積頻數圖中，40 kg 的累積頻數為 35，60 kg 為 80。總數為 100，求重量介乎 40 與 60 kg 的項目數量。

subject: maths
question_en:
The frequency table shows the number of siblings of 10 students. Find the median.

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|} \hline \text{Siblings} & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\\hline \text{Frequency} & 2 & 3 & 4 & 1 \\\hline \end{array}
$$
question_zh: 下表顯示 10 名學生的兄弟姐妹人數。求數據的中位數。
solution_steps_en: 1. $n = 10$. Median is average of 5th and 6th values.
solution_steps_zh: 1. $n = 10$。中位數是第 5 個及第 6 個數值的平均值。
3. 第 5 個是 1，第 6 個是 2。
